name: Staying Strike
body:
Prerequisite(s): Sudden Strike class feature

Benefit(s): When you hit a target and deal sudden strike damage, you may choose to lessen the damage to stagger your opponent.

For each die of damage you lessen the sudden strike by, the opponent gains the staggered condition for an equal number of rounds. For example, if you were to lessen the sudden strike by two dice worth of damage, the struck target would be staggered for two rounds.
